answers.rationale: The history supports a conditional preference to avoid rentals when rideshares keep the itinerary simple, not a fixed no-car rule. A downtown-to-Meridian-to-downtown workday has repeated time-sensitive cross-city legs, so a compact rental is the calibrated choice for control and reliability.

The user has chosen an event hotel when meetings are in that building or an early same-site start makes it materially safer, but has selected a nearby breakfast hotel when the official events are elsewhere and the walk is practical. Since the convention center, not the block hotel, hosts the sessions and the block mainly serves the opening reception, Hampton Uptown is the better calibrated lodging choice.

The record does not show a fixed refundable-only preference; flexibility was valued when plans, weather, or transportation were unsettled, while the user has said prepaid is acceptable when savings are real. With a fixed wedding, locked flights and dates, identical room and breakfast terms, and material savings, the direct prepaid king rate is appropriate.

History shows that refundable rates are used when logistics remain open, rather than a stable preference for flexibility regardless of circumstances. Here the graduation dates, room type, breakfast, and direct folio are fixed, and the direct nonrefundable rate is materially cheaper, so booking it is the calibrated action.
